# BD Workspace — Bình Dương SSO Lab

> Local lab: Zimbra mail login for Directus + ABP Framework via Keycloak (OIDC/OAuth2). No GitHub/CI yet.

## Architecture

- [Workspace Architecture](docs/workspace-architecture.md): SSO model, services, local ports, role mapping. Source of truth.
- [Project Overview / PDR](docs/project-overview-pdr.md): Goals, scope, non-goals for the BD lab.
- [System Architecture](docs/system-architecture.md): Component view of Zimbra → Keycloak → apps.
- [README](README.md): Workspace layout and local quick start.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): AI agent rules (Vietnamese).
- [SSO Guideline Diagram](system-sso-guideline.png): Official login-flow diagram.

## Services

- [Directus](services/directus-main/readme.md): Clinical data management. OIDC client of Keycloak. Docker compose includes Keycloak on port 5110.
- [ABP Blazor Microservice](services/abp-blazor/README.md): Digital administration (docs, approvals). AuthServer (OpenIddict) + Blazor UI + microservices; integrate Keycloak as external IdP.
- Keycloak (Docker): Identity provider — user federation from Zimbra LDAP/AD, realm clients for Directus and ABP.

## Local defaults

- Keycloak: http://localhost:5110 (admin / secret) via `services/directus-main/docker-compose.yml`
- Directus / ABP: follow each service README for run ports and env

## Out of scope (legacy Task9)

Task9 UI/API/worker/n8n/metabase stacks and their docs/plans are archived history only — not authoritative for BD.
